claude.sample_unit: retrieved chunks (594 baseline A-line, 6 optimized B-line)

links.outcome: Retrieved chunk quality for baseline versus optimized (restructured) knowledge documents
links.effect: Baseline A-line chunk median scores were 2.0 or below on all five metrics with fewer than 20% reaching practical utility; optimized B-line achieved perfect scores across all metrics (6 chunks, proof of concept).
links.quote: The B-line optimization achieved perfect scores across all metrics, demonstrating potential for improvement.

unlisted_practices: Restructuring and curating source knowledge documents (structure, granularity, noise) before RAG deployment
LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation of retrieved chunk quality

links.effect: Fleiss kappa value was 0.269, described as fair.
links.quote: The inter-rater agreement in the Level 1 evaluation was fair (Fleiss kappa value of 0.269), indicating the need for framework refinement.

links.effect: Median scores were 2.0 or below across all five metrics; fewer than 20% reached score ≥4.
links.quote: The results revealed substantial quality limitations in the A-line chunks: the median scores were 2.0 or below across all five metrics, with fewer than 20% of the chunks reaching practical utility thresholds (score of 4 or higher).

unlisted_practices: Prepare and restructure RAG knowledge documents for clearer organization, formatting, granularity, and reduced noise before ingestion.
